>Q13. Read this file into R and determine the sample size for each genotype and their corresponding median expression levels for each of these genotypes

First read the population data 
```{r}

# Read in the population data
expr <- read.table("https://bioboot.github.io/bggn213_W19/class-material/rs8067378_ENSG00000172057.6.txt")

head(expr)


```

```{r}
nrow(expr)
```

```{r}
table(expr$geno)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

Let's make a boxplot
```{r}
ggplot(expr) + aes(geno, exp, fill=geno) + 
  geom_boxplot(notch=TRUE)
```

Now, let's find the median expression levels: 

```{r}
# Save boxplot statistics
b <- boxplot(exp ~ geno, data = expr, plot = FALSE)

# View the sample sizes for each genotypes
b$names
b$n
```

```{r}

#FInd median expression and check it 

b$stats[3, ]
tapply(expr$exp, expr$geno, median)
```

>Q14.  Generate a boxplot with a box per genotype, what could you infer from the relative
expression value between A/A and G/G displayed in this plot? Does the SNP effect the
expression of ORMDL3?


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(expr) + aes(geno, exp, fill = geno) +
  geom_boxplot(notch = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "ORMDL3 Expression by Genotype",
       x = "Genotype",
       y = "ORMDL3 Expression")

```
